## What's new

### Query language

- A schema of declared fields gives a query language with `key:value` terms, negation, `OR`, groups, ranges and quoting (0010751).
- Number fields read units and spans through a parse hook (a62aa46, 09e1446).
- A `CustomField` can take bare words, check its values and require all of them to hold (764645f, a5f341b, 6a85384).
- Dynamic fields accept keys the schema does not declare, up to a bounded number (5b53222, 18c0df2).
- The parser never throws, and each diagnostic's span is the fragment it names (046acbb, 461cb2b).
- The query language imports without Textual (4e42d11).

### Textual widgets

- `SearchBar`, `CompletingInput`, `TextInput` and `Cycle` give a search bar with tab completion (686f482).
- `SearchBar` underlines each diagnostic where it is in the query (ec1cbfa).
- `without()` and `SearchBar.unpin` support an "all" tab (5dd4257).
- Completion and cycle values are shown as text, never as markup, and control characters are shown rather than sent (4e55ec9, 25717a6).

### TypeScript port

- `catsearch` is a dependency-free TypeScript port of the same language, at 12.9 kB minified and gzipped (4e52e6e).
- A shared spec, differential fuzzing against Python and property tests hold the two implementations to the same answers (e898975, abdaf0b, 9ac0683).
- A Discord-style search bar example shows completed values attached to their key as one chip, in light and dark themes (b550590, 6bf7431, 29322ac).

### Docs and packaging

- A Furo docs site with the live web demo is at https://kaierikniermann.github.io/textual-catsearch/ (32b6ff4, 4007205).
- This release attaches the Python wheel and sdist (`textual-catsearch`) and the npm tarball (`catsearch-0.1.0.tgz`), each install-tested in CI before it is attached (80914d5).
